allow: PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, AdapterRAM, DriverVersion | Format-List; Write-Output "---- CPU / RAM ----"; Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors | Format-List; "{0:N1} GB RAM" -f \(\(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem\).TotalPhysicalMemory / 1GB\); Write-Output "---- nvidia-smi ----"; if \(Get-Command nvidia-smi -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv } else { "nvidia-smi not found \(no NVIDIA driver on PATH\)" })
